backend_memory_pressure.sampling_scope: non-atomic counters; periodic and labelled boundaries; samples may miss transient peaks; inspect timestamps for gaps
backend_memory_pressure.scope: common parent budget spans all backend epochs and retained charges; identical child limits for each worker and descendants; driver excluded; cgroup charges are not RSS or exact retained heap; uncharged ZFS ARC and host caches remain outside this budget
backend_memory_pressure.startup_scope: worker attaches before runtime and backend construction; loader and argument-parsing charges incurred before migration are not retroactively transferred

memory_diagnostic.backend_process_definition: backend, service adapter, runtime, and loopback transport in the worker process; not a pure native allocator RSS measurement
memory_diagnostic.label: memory-only diagnostic; loopback QUIC/TLS transport adds costs and does not replace direct-path throughput or latency evidence
memory_diagnostic.process_group_scope: sum of sampled harness-process and backend-process RSS/PSS for the recorded PID/starttime identities

vdev_mapping.scope: whole host device counter; unrelated concurrent I/O is not attributed to this workload
